people.name: Mary
people.line: Mother of Jesus; wife of Joseph.

translations.web: The angel said to her, “Don’t be afraid, Mary, for you have found favor with God.
translations.bsb: So the angel told her, “Do not be afraid, Mary, for you have found favor with God.
translations.kjv: And the angel said unto her, Fear not, Mary: for thou hast found favour with God.
translations.asv: And the angel said unto her, Fear not, Mary: for thou hast found favor with God.
